clauses.title: Net pay funding
clauses.text: Treasury funds net pay to the processor's impound account two business days before the pay date, equal to register net pay.

clauses.title: ACH settlement
clauses.text: Each direct deposit equals the employee's register net pay and goes to the account on file in the payroll census.

clauses.title: ACH returns
clauses.text: Returned deposits are reissued within one business day, by off-cycle deposit to the corrected account or by check.

clauses.title: Shared accounts
clauses.text: No two employees may deposit to the same bank account without HR documentation.

clauses.title: Tax remittance
clauses.text: Employee withholdings and employer taxes on the register are funded and remitted to each jurisdiction in full each cycle.

clauses.title: Benefit remittance
clauses.text: 401(k) deferrals and medical premiums withheld are remitted to the recordkeeper and carrier each pay date.

clauses.title: Journal entry
clauses.text: The payroll journal entry balances and posts wages by employee class and cost center: union 6010, non-union hourly 6020, salaried 6030, premium 6040, PTO 6050.

clauses.title: Cost-center mapping
clauses.text: Every cost center on the register is in the GL map. Postings to 9999 Suspense must be reclassed before month-end close.

clauses.title: Taxes and liabilities
clauses.text: Employer tax expense (6100) and payroll liabilities (2200, 2210, 2220) equal the register.

clauses.title: Vacation accrual
clauses.text: The vacation accrual true-up equals the change in validated vacation balances, valued at each employee's rate.
